sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:99

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:99:1
items.html: In the Musaf prayer it is done through the act of the lower beings, through their prayer, whereas then they ascended by themselves etc. That is, as explained in the adjacent item (the passage beginning “And the answer is”), that in the first Ibur [impregnation] the lower one rises and is sorted through the upper one — that is, at the time when the upper one sorts its AHP — for the AHP of the upper one are always attached to the GE of the lower one, and therefore they are corrected together. And this is what he says, “for indeed Adam had not yet been created” — for in the first Ibur the NRN [Nefesh, Ruach, Neshama] of Adam were still lying, mixed, in the shells, and he had no existence at all in holiness; and if so, how could he rise by himself in the discernment of MAN [Mayin Nukvin]? As written above (page 1946, the passage beginning “And the answer”). However, in the second Ibur, for the need of the Mochin of Gadlut [greatness/adulthood], man himself can already rise in the secret of MAN to his upper one, for he already has at least the discernment of VAK [six ends], and he can rise on his own. As written there.
